tasks.short: Evaluate philosophy and religion work and provide grades and feedback

steps.what: Check the actual assignment, assessment criteria and relevant course texts
outputs: teacher-confirmed assessment requirements

steps.what: Read the student's actual work and examine its argument, interpretation and use of sources
outputs: teacher's actual reading observations and submission annotations

steps.what: Evaluate the work against the criteria and determine the actual grade and feedback points
inputs: teacher's actual reading observations and submission annotations
outputs: teacher-determined grade and actual marking notes

steps.what: Draft and finish checking feedback from the teacher's marking notes and cited submission passages
inputs: teacher-determined grade and actual marking notes
teacher's actual reading observations and submission annotations
outputs: complete checked grade and teacher-edited feedback for the correct student

loop.purpose: Turn the teacher's actual feedback points into a readable draft
loop.input: Actual marking notes, rubric and source-located submission passages
loop.output: Unpublished feedback prose with each point linked to the relevant note and passage
loop.check: Teacher verifies argument meaning, quotations, criterion alignment and tone; no model grade or unsupported criticism
loop.stop: One draft and correction round; unsupported points revert to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native comment banks supply repeated phrases but do not express the teacher's specific argument-level observations

steps.what: Release the exact checked grade and feedback to the correct student in the LMS
inputs: complete checked grade and teacher-edited feedback for the correct student
outputs: released teacher-set grade and feedback

tasks.design: Use native rubric and comment tools in {LMS} first, then a bounded prose draft only from the teacher's actual marking notes and submission passages. The teacher reads, judges, sets the grade and checks the complete student-specific feedback before release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expressing individual argument-level feedback can require repeated prose drafting after judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded drafting step can restate actual teacher observations with source links for checking.
tasks.still_hard: Judge philosophical reasoning, interpretation and source use fairly.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the student's argument and own the grade.

ambition.what: Assist feedback expression without automated grading.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-10; assessment-owner approval, student-data access and teacher consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: language models can draft feedback prose from actual instructor notes, but interpretation, grading and source verification remain teacher work.

assumptions: Students produce actual submissions. Teacher produces reading annotations and marking notes in s2-s3; no model invents a grade or evidence. Additional source-passage preparation beyond normal annotations is explicitly incremental.
Native rubric/comment banks first. No automated misconduct judgement or grade recommendation. Final checking is part of feedback authoring; short release is fully retained.

Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 5.7 minus 2 additional passage/note preparation and 1 draft-setting upkeep gives 2.7 net. If normal notes do not support drafting or review takes longer, use manual feedback.
unknowns: Actual existing annotations, passage preparation and feedback correction effort
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total feedback time after counting passage preparation and every corrected interpretation?

already_counted.description: Review and finish exact feedback and grade package

incremental.description: Prepare source-located passages beyond normal marking annotations
Maintain bounded feedback settings and sample-check failures

approvals.approved_version: complete exact student grade/feedback package checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if added preparation and correction erase gains; cautious range below provisional 2.7% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Initiate, facilitate and moderate classroom discussions

steps.what: Pose the actual discussion question and frame the relevant philosophical or religious issue for the class
inputs: actual course issue and assigned text
outputs: classroom discussion initiated with an explicit question

steps.what: Facilitate and moderate actual student discussion, balance participation and probe reasoning
inputs: classroom discussion initiated with an explicit question
outputs: actual classroom discussion moderated

steps.what: Address actual misunderstandings and draw connections among arguments raised during the discussion
outputs: actual misconceptions addressed and arguments connected

tasks.design: Retain direct discussion facilitation. Assigned texts in {DOCS} support the course, but a template or generated discussion does not perform the live moderation and reasoning work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Discussion depends on actual contributions, disagreement and participation.
tasks.enabler_now: No new digital input replaces live facilitation in this task.
tasks.still_hard: Probe reasoning fairly while managing a sensitive or contested topic.
tasks.human_edge: Hear what students mean and respond constructively.

ambition.what: Keep live classroom discussion with the teacher.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0; no new classroom recording or processing

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: classroom discussion facilitation requires responding to actual student arguments and participation.

assumptions: This task is actual classroom facilitation. No separate written discussion report, grade entry or send is established; any actual local participation record must be mapped independently before estimating it.
Native course texts and discussion prompts considered, but preparing a course or lecture is a different task. No recurring administrative baseline is added to live discussion.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. All work retained, gross and net zero.
unknowns: Whether an actual separate participation record is required
research_questions: Observe discussion and any actual record entry separately; which work is genuinely repeated?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual live moderation and interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and deliver lectures on ethics, logic and religious thought

steps.what: Select and study actual primary texts and reliable course sources for the intended topic and audience
inputs: authorized primary texts and course sources
outputs: teacher-selected source passages and intended arguments

steps.what: Draft a lecture outline and explanatory transitions from the selected passages and teacher's intended arguments
inputs: teacher-selected source passages and intended arguments
outputs: unpublished source-linked lecture draft

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory structure around teacher-selected texts
loop.input: Actual passages, source locators, intended arguments and audience
loop.output: Unpublished outline and transitions with source locators
loop.check: Teacher checks quotations, argument validity, interpretive disagreements and source support; no invented authorities
loop.stop: One draft/revision round; unsupported sections are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Native lecture templates supply layout but do not propose topic-specific explanatory transitions

steps.what: Revise and finish checking the lecture material against actual sources and the intended interpretation
inputs: teacher-selected source passages and intended arguments
outputs: complete checked lecture material

steps.what: Save the checked lecture material in the existing course document project
outputs: saved lecture material

steps.what: Deliver the lecture to the actual student or community audience and adapt explanations as needed
outputs: actual lecture delivered

steps.what: Answer actual questions and clarify disputed interpretations or reasoning
outputs: actual lecture questions addressed

tasks.design: Use native lecture structure in {DOCS}, then a bounded draft from the teacher's actual source passages and intended arguments. The teacher checks quotations and reasoning, finishes the material and delivers the lecture directly.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning selected texts into a coherent explanatory outline requires prose drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded model can propose transitions grounded in provided passages for teacher revision.
tasks.still_hard: Represent contested ideas accurately and make reasoning understandable to this audience.
tasks.human_edge: Choose and defend an interpretation and respond to questions.

ambition.what: Assist lecture drafting without replacing scholarship or delivery.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: language models can draft outlines from provided passages, but philosophical reasoning, quotations and contested interpretations need expert verification.

assumptions: Teacher produces selected passages and intended arguments in s1. Their preparation is counted; no invented bibliography or unsupported quotation. Sources are actual provided documents, not URLs fabricated by a model.
Native layout/reusable material first. Draft review in s2 and full source checking in s3 remain. No material distribution send is hidden in save or lecture delivery.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 5 minus 1 draft-setting/source upkeep gives 4 net. Actual scholarship, lecture delivery and 1% same-system save remain.
unknowns: Actual draft correction effort and source-preparation needs
research_questions: Does a source-grounded outline reduce total preparation after every corrected quotation and argument?

already_counted.description: Review draft and finish source checking

incremental.description: Maintain source-grounded drafting settings and inspect unsupported claims

approvals.approved_version: complete lecture material checked at end of s3; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if correction erases drafting gains; cautious range below provisional 4% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compile and check the exact exam, question keys, open-answer criteria, cohort and release settings using a native item bank
inputs: actual learning outcomes and exam specification
outputs: complete checked exact examination, keys, criteria and cohort settings

steps.what: Release the exact checked examination to the intended cohort under the checked settings
inputs: complete checked exact examination, keys, criteria and cohort settings
outputs: actual exam released to intended students

steps.what: Administer the actual examination, address permitted procedural questions and collect actual responses
inputs: actual exam released to intended students
students' actual exam participation and responses
outputs: actual exam responses and administration exceptions

steps.what: Mark only fixed-key closed questions and calculate their provisional score totals
inputs: actual exam responses and administration exceptions
complete checked exact examination, keys, criteria and cohort settings
outputs: provisional fixed-key scores with unanswered and exception flags

steps.what: Read and grade open answers using actual reasoning and interpretation against the exam criteria
inputs: actual exam responses and administration exceptions
complete checked exact examination, keys, criteria and cohort settings
outputs: teacher-set open-answer marks and rationale

steps.what: Check actual responses, key exceptions, arithmetic and student identity, then determine the exact final exam results
inputs: provisional fixed-key scores with unanswered and exception flags
actual exam responses and administration exceptions
outputs: complete checked teacher-set final results for the correct students

steps.what: Publish only the exact checked final exam results to the correct students
inputs: complete checked teacher-set final results for the correct students
outputs: published teacher-set exam results

tasks.design: Configure native item-bank assembly and fixed-key marking in {LMS}. The teacher checks the complete exam before release, administers it, grades all open reasoning and checks actual results before final publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated item formatting and fixed-key marking can duplicate work already represented by an item bank.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exam tools can assemble reviewed questions and mark unambiguous fixed-key responses.
tasks.still_hard: Assess open philosophical or theological reasoning and resolve ambiguous responses.
tasks.human_edge: Own exam validity and every final grade.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated exam assembly and closed-key marking without automated essay judgement.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-10; assessment-owner approval, student-data access and teacher consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native LMS exam tools support item banks and fixed-key marking; open reasoning and final results need examiner judgement.

assumptions: Scenario has both actual fixed-key and open questions; the mix is provisional, not an observed exam distribution. Teacher-authored reviewed items/keys are existing inputs; new question authorship and item-bank capture are not silently treated as free.

Native exam configuration first. Students produce actual responses during s3. No language model grades belief, interpretation or essays; fixed-key results remain draft until teacher checks them. Already configured exams receive no new saving.

Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 21.8 minus 2 item-bank/key upkeep gives 19.8 net. Exam and result publication are separate 1% fully retained steps; source exam and coursework grading are distinct artifacts, counted once.
unknowns: Actual closed/open mix, item-bank completeness and existing native marking use
research_questions: How much actual formatting and fixed-key marking remains manual, and do key/exception checks preserve examiner decisions?

already_counted.description: Check compiled exam and actual final results

incremental.description: Maintain reviewed item-bank mappings, fixed keys and exception checks

approvals.approved_version: complete exact exam, keys, criteria, cohort and settings checked at end of s1; edits void check
exact final student results checked at end of s6; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if no fixed-key component or native tools already used; cautious range below provisional 19.8% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Assessment owners govern exam configuration; teachers retain interpretation, grading and live teaching.
skills_to_grow: Ground feedback and lecture drafts in actual passages
Use native item banks without automating open judgement
Check exact student/cohort versions before release
role.ambitious_version: Reduce verified repeated drafting and exam mechanics while preserving philosophical interpretation, live discussion and examiner decisions.
